name: SW-$A^2$-Bench
description: The Agentic Web is emerging as a paradigm in which autonomous software agents interact with online resources and with each other to accomplish user goals. However, the capacity of Agentic Web is still limited by insufficient autonomous software agent population, which has become a crucial challenge for scaling Agentic Web. In order to alleviate this, we study the task of automatically converting existing code repositories into autonomous software agents via coding agents, decompose the process into critical stages, and identify key technical hurdles.
